## Shared platform rules

- Multi-repo under GitHub org `carteracredit` (`blocks` is `algtools/blocks`). **Two Cloudflare accounts** (ADR 0019, supersedes ADR 0001): the dev account owns `carteracredit.workers.dev` with bare names; the prod account keeps `*-prod` workers and `*.cartera.credit`. Ephemeral stacks run only on the dev account (ADR 0011). Deploy via Workers Builds on push (not GHA, except `workflow-template` which deploys from `release.yml`, plus dev-account preview stacks).
- Never local-deploy Workers from an agent (Workers Builds / CI owns deploy).
- Local/desktop agents: do not commit or push unless the user asks. Cloud agents: commit and push with conventional commits so PRs/CI can run. Unless the user names `main`, a hotfix, or `/promote`, branch from `origin/dev` and open the PR **into `dev`** so ADR 0011 previews run (`https://<slug>-<worker>.carteracredit.workers.dev` / `https://<svc>-<slug>.carteracredit.workers.dev`). Relink checks out the PR branch (`client_payload.branch`), never `main`. `harness` has no `dev` — stay on `main`. Do not run `preview:upload` / `preview-stack.mjs` from the agent.
- Never hand-bump package `version` — semantic-release owns it.
- Repos with `dev`: land product work (including library pins) on dev.
  `main` is reached only by promoting dev, except a rare hotfix. Do not
  open the same change on dev and `main` in parallel. **After every
  stable `chore(release)` or hotfix on `main`, merge `main` back into dev**
  (fast-forward when dev has nothing new). Skipping that fold makes the
  next dev → `main` PR conflict on `package.json` / CHANGELOG. Do not
  re-promote a dev-sync-only merge. `/promote` opens the pull request from `dev` into `main`. Do not create a side branch for it. Runbook:
  [`harness/platform/promote-dev-to-main.md`](../harness/platform/promote-dev-to-main.md)
  (`/promote`). ADR 0010.
- Prefer service-binding RPC between Workers; Bearer JWT for frontend→Worker (except auth-svc cookies).
- English URL path segments only. Engineering language is English (code,
  comments, commits, PRs, docs, agent replies) even when the prompt is
  Spanish — ADR 0013. Product locales: `en-US` primary, `es-US` secondary.
  Locale catalogs may hold UI copy with English keys. Spanglish in source
  or docs is a defect.
- Update harness context when contracts/bindings change (`/update-context`).

## Worker class

Stack: Hono on Cloudflare Workers, Prisma 7 + D1 (except `workflow-svc`: raw SQL), Vitest + `@cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers`, Sentry. OpenAPI via chanfana; Scalar at `/docsz`.

- Quality gate: `pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run vitest:coverage`.
- Local `test` often runs without coverage — CI uses `vitest:coverage`.
- Env files: `wrangler.jsonc` (dev account, bare D1 names) / `wrangler.prod.jsonc` (prod account, `*-prod` worker name) / `wrangler.test.jsonc`. Ephemeral stacks generate gitignored `wrangler.preview.jsonc` on the dev account (ADR 0011). Committed preview configs are retired.
- Organization-scope queries by JWT `organizationId`; Zod-validate inputs.
- Collection list GETs: `q` or `query`, `limit` default 20 / max 100, `cursor` → `nextCursor`. Prisma `{ contains }` only — no `mode: insensitive`. Do not paginate detail embeds.
- Additive SQL migrations in `migrations/`.
- When changing routes, verify OpenAPI/Scalar docs at `/docsz`. Only `OpenAPIRoute` handlers mounted on the `fromHono(...)` return value appear in the schema.
- Prefer RPC service bindings (`AuthSvcEntrypoint`, `CasesSvcEntrypoint`, …) over HTTP internal tokens.

## Worker notes

- Hono on Cloudflare Workers; Prisma 7 + D1 where applicable (`workflow-svc` is raw SQL).
- Organization-scope every query by `organizationId` from the JWT, never from the body.
- Prefer service-binding RPC over HTTP internal tokens.
- Collection lists: `q`/`query` + `limit`/`cursor`/`nextCursor`. Walk pages for catalogs. Do not paginate detail embeds.
- Additive SQL migrations in `migrations/` matching Prisma schema (or D1 SQL).

### Service bindings (dev)

- `WORKFLOW_SVC` → `workflow-svc` (WorkflowSvcEntrypoint)
- `NOTIFICATIONS_SERVICE` → `notifications-svc` (NotificationsEntrypoint)
- `AUTH_SERVICE` → `auth-svc` (AuthSvcEntrypoint)
- `CASES_SVC` → `cases-svc` (CasesSvcEntrypoint)
- `PROXY_SVC` → `proxy-svc` (ProxySvcEntrypoint)

## Hard rules

- Never local `wrangler deploy` / `pnpm deploy*` — CI / Workers Builds owns deploy.
- Local/desktop agents: do not commit/push unless the user asks. Cloud agents: commit and push with conventional commits. Branch from `origin/dev` and open the PR into `dev` (harness: `main` only) unless the user asked for a hotfix or `/promote`. That PR starts ADR 0011 previews.
- Never hand-bump `version` in package.json — semantic-release owns versions.
- If you change a cross-service contract, binding, or durable fact: update `## Learnings` and the matching `harness/platform/` doc in the same task.
- After a stable release or hotfix on `main`, merge `main` back into dev before the next dev → `main` PR (ADR 0010). Fast-forward when dev has nothing new. Do not re-promote a dev-sync-only merge.
- Engineering language is English (ADR 0013). Product locales are `en-US` (primary) and `es-US` (secondary). Prompts may be any language; replies, code, comments, commits, PRs, and docs stay English unless the user explicitly asks for a chat reply in another language. Spanglish is a defect.
